name: Locating BRT lanes outside the roadways
short_definition: Recommended to minimize risks/accidents for pedestrians and BRT users by reducing conflicts between BRT vehicles and other road users.

name: Awareness campaign and fines
short_definition: Addresses pedestrian traffic rule violations and reduces negligence contributing to unnecessary accidents involving road users.

name: Special considerations in designs, operation and management
short_definition: Creates a safe environment for potential BRT users including schoolchildren, the elderly, and individuals with disabilities.
